catalogMeta.label: Make a Word (open build)
catalogMeta.description: Open build: tap prefix, root and suffix cards (each printed with its meaning) into a row to MAKE a word for a stated meaning, then press done; some items ask for a second, different word. Many words pass (replay, redo, rewrite for "do it again"); the row's shape is checked in code and the word by the shared literacy judge. Grades 1-8, scoped to the lesson grade. β = simple_affix + 0.1, the offset build_n has over give_me_n.

buildItems.ask: Make a word that means it already happened.
Make a word that means you are doing it right now.
Make a word that means to do something one more time.
